observation.kind: instrumented partial CPU/heap diagnostic, not a valid latency/verdict sample

cpu_diagnostic.interpretation: Nested cumulative frames overlap; do not add percentages. Window is from ab8e2bea before metadata reuse; interrupted diagnostic is not a successful latency or verdict sample.

metric_limits: ReadFile bytes are logical bytes returned by that API, not physical I/O or complete Open/Read coverage.
cloneSpec entries count semantic clone calls, not all runtime memory copies.
Git stdout counts include expected failed parent resolution for a root commit; stderr and physical I/O are not estimated.
Atomic coverage fixtures measure function entries; their runtimes are not native command baselines.

limits: Interactive shared host, not a quiescent lab; concurrent development/validation occurred. Timings are observations, not causal percentages or a latency SLO.
Published check-strict timed out in all three 600-second samples; no median or exact speedup is fabricated.
Native benchmarks pin corpus fdefae55 and their exact binary digests; later fallback/framing fixes were separately regression-tested and must receive final local validation.
Small fixtures do not prove thousands of records fit the retention budget; fallback preserves the complete live path.
No CI observation or pass is claimed; Harne8 adoption and operator modifications are outside this work.
